mapper.select: WITH RECURSIVE date_range AS ( SELECT #{sdate} AS FLOW_DATE UNION ALL SELECT DATE_ADD(FLOW_DATE, INTERVAL 1 DAY) FROM date_range WHERE FLOW_DATE < #{edate} ) SELECT IFNULL(rh.FLOW_AVR, -99999) AS FLOW, dr.FLOW_DATE, DAYOFMONTH(dr.FLOW_DATE) AS NUM FROM date_range dr LEFT JOIN flow_hist rh ON DATE(rh.FLOW_DATE) = dr.FLOW_DATE AND rh.DATA_TYPE = #{type} AND rh.AREA_CODE = #{area_code} ORDER BY dr.FLOW_DATE
